gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a Blink or Wyze camera sold for indoor use only keeps its weather rating at an outdoor feeder when it runs on the maker's own outdoor adapter. For the Blink Mini 2 that is the Blink Weather Resistant Power Adapter. For the Wyze Cam OG it is the Wyze Outdoor Power Adapter v2, $13.98 at wyze.com on 2026-11-17. None of those results says either that Blink's current Outdoor 2K+ saves clips with no plan only through a Sync Module 2 (USB) or Sync Module XR (microSD) bought separately, because the Sync Module Core has no local storage.
standout_why: I compared against the four cited pages. Wyze 'Is 24/7 Local Recording going away' says only that every Wyze Cam with a microSD slot records with no plan: it has no model list and no outdoor or power conditions. Wyze 'Can Wyze Cam v3 record events continuously' covers recording modes only. Blink 'Local Storage with Sync Module' and 'Blink Storage Options' do exclude the Sync Module Core and the XT, XT2 and Indoor (1st Gen) from local storage, so that part is already in a cited source. But neither lists the Outdoor 2K+ as able to use local storage, and neither says anything about outdoor power for the Mini 2. ChatGPT's answer said 'compatible Sync Module' without naming the Core trap. It also told shoppers to mount the camera at the feeder without saying that the Mini 2, Wyze Cam OG and Wyze Cam v3/v4 need a separate outdoor adapter to be weather-rated. Wyze's Bird Feeder compatibility page (result 25) says wired Wyze cams need the Wyze Outdoor Power Adapter, but ChatGPT did not cite it and it does not cover Blink.
decides: This confirms the pick, the Wasserstein case plus the camera the shopper already owns, and adds a parts list for each camera. Wyze Cam OG/v3/v3 Pro/v4 owners add a microSD card and the $13.98 Wyze Outdoor Power Adapter (wyze.com lists it as working with Cam v3/v3 Pro/v4 and the OG series). Wyze Battery Cam Pro owners need no adapter: it records to microSD with no plan, but without Cam Plus each motion clip is about 12 s. Blink Outdoor 4 and Outdoor 2K+ owners whose kit came with a Sync Module Core must buy a Sync Module 2 plus a USB drive, or a Sync Module XR plus a microSD card, to save clips with no plan. Blink Mini 2 owners need the Weather Resistant Power Adapter to mount it outside. Owners of the XT, XT2 or Indoor (1st Gen) cannot use local storage at all and are limited to 7,200 s of cloud storage per Sync Module.

findings.label: Local storage support
findings.value: None: does not support Local Storage or Clip Backup; not sold separately (comes in bundles)
findings.source_title: Sync Module Requirements for Blink Devices — Blink Support
findings.note: The 'not sold separately' wording is on this page. Blink Storage Options (cited by ChatGPT) also says Core has no local storage, so that part is not new.

findings.label: Ways to save clips with no plan
findings.value: Sync Module 2 with a USB flash drive, or Sync Module XR with a microSD card, both sold separately; a Sync Module is required
findings.note: The Sync Module Requirements page puts Outdoor 2K+ in the 'Sync Module Required' column. The FAQ says it does not support Extended Range, which is for the Outdoor 4 only. Low-light Color Vision and person/vehicle detection need a plan or trial.

findings.label: Outdoor use condition
findings.value: IP65; weather resistance guaranteed only on the Blink Weather Resistant Power Adapter (sold separately); -20 to 45 °C (-5 to 113 °F)
findings.note: The same FAQ says Mini 2 does not need a Sync Module but gets Local Storage when added to a system with a Sync Module 2. Live View sessions are 60 s by default and can be extended to 5 min.

findings.label: Local storage exclusion
findings.value: No Local Storage or Clip Backup; 7,200 s of cloud storage per Sync Module
findings.source_title: Local Storage with Sync Module — Blink Support
findings.note: This page was cited by ChatGPT, so the finding is not new. It is listed so the compatibility table is complete.

findings.product: Blink Sync Module 2 / Sync Module XR
findings.label: Storage media limits
findings.value: Sync Module 2: USB Type-A drive, 1–256 GB, at least 375 MB free, exFAT recommended. Sync Module XR: microSD card, 1–256 GB, at least 10 Mbps read/write. XR is sold and usable only in the US and Canada.
findings.source_title: Local Storage with Sync Module — Blink Support
findings.note: The US/Canada-only rule for XR is from the Sync Module XR FAQ, https://support.blinkforhome.com/en_US/f-a-q/sync-module-xr-faq, read 2026-11-17.

findings.label: Compatible Wyze cameras
findings.value: Wyze Cam Outdoor v1/v2, Battery Cam Pro, Cam v3, Cam v3 Pro, Cam v4 (the v4 carries an asterisk the page never explains); wired cams need a Wyze Outdoor Power Adapter
findings.source_title: Which Wyze Cams are compatible with Wyze Bird Feeder? – Wyze
findings.note: Read through the Zendesk API; the article was last updated 2024-10-14. The Wyze Cam OG is not on the list. wyze.com sells a 'Bird Feeder Plug-in Cam v4 Bundle' at $89.98 (read 2026-11-17).

findings.label: Outdoor use condition
findings.value: IP65; outdoor use requires the Wyze Outdoor Power Adapter v2
findings.source_title: Can I use Wyze Cam OG outdoors? – Wyze

findings.label: Price and compatibility
findings.value: $13.98 (compare-at $18.98). Works with Cam v3/v3 Pro/v4, OG series, Pan v3/v4 and Duo Cam Pan; the kit with L-shaped and USB-C adapters adds Battery Cam Pro; does NOT work with the OG Stack Kit; IP67
findings.note: Read from Wyze's Shopify store with storecheck.py; listed as in stock.

findings.label: No-plan microSD recording
findings.value: Continuous recording to microSD with no plan (cards up to 256 GB, about 2–3 days of footage). Events Only without Cam Plus gives clips of about 12 s with a cooldown; with Cam Plus, clips run up to 5 min with no cooldown. Wyze recommends 5 V 2 A AC power for continuous recording.
findings.source_title: Using MicroSD Cards with Wyze Battery Cam Pro – Wyze
findings.note: The article was last updated 2026-06-05. It was in ChatGPT's results (rank 24) but not cited.

findings.label: Fit, power and focus (named reviewer)
findings.value: Designed for Blink Outdoor, Ring Stick Up Cam, Wyze Cam Outdoor and Wyze Cam v3. Has a rear opening for power cables and takes Wasserstein solar panels. Adam Juniper (Digital Camera World) found birds sat closer than the Ring Stick Up's nearest focus distance.
findings.source_title: Wasserstein Bird Feeder Smart Case review: Bird watching made easy? — Digital Camera World
findings.note: The review is dated 2023-04-04, so its fit list predates the Outdoor 4 and Wyze Cam OG. The power and solar details also appear on Wasserstein's mounting guide, https://wasserstein-home.com/blogs/smart-home/how-to-mount-the-wasserstein-bird-feeder-camera-case (read 2026-11-17), which says the case works with 'Blink, Wyze, and Ring Cam models' using the right spacer and adapter.
